title.full: Getting papers for a foreign newborn

summary.text: Get a travel document for your child from the embassy or High Commission within 42 days of birth.

steps.name: Get a travel document
steps.text: Obtain a travel document for your child from the respective Embassy or High Commission within 42 days of your child's birth.

example_phrasings: How many days can a foreign newborn baby stay in Singapore?
How long can my foreign newborn stay?
When must I get papers for my newborn?

sources.page_title: How many days can a foreign newborn baby stay in Singapore?

quotes.text: You will need to obtain a travel document for your child from the respective Embassy or High Commission within 42 days of your child's birth.
